headline: Property Manager Caliber Halts Crypto Purchases Amid Debt Obligations
summary: Caliber halted cryptocurrency buying after allocating $12.6 million into LINK last year, leaving it with $1.8 million in cash and $18.6 million in notes due within a year.
why: Corporate liquidity constraints and upcoming debt maturities force non-core asset sales or spending freezes in distressed firms.

impacts.name: CaliberCos Inc
impacts.why: Tight cash reserves and high short-term debt pose credit risks.
